description: Unauthenticated RCE in React Server Components Flight protocol deserializer via crafted HTTP request.
mitigation: Upgrade React to >= 19.2.1 and Next.js to >= 15.1.9 or >= 16.0.7.

description: Excessive CPU usage and event loop blocking in App Router Server Actions.
mitigation: Enforce per-route rate limiting and request timeouts on all Server Actions.

description: Middleware and routing proxy bypass in Turbopack development and edge runtimes.
mitigation: Upgrade Next.js and avoid relying solely on middleware for route-level authorization.

description: Unvalidated parameters in filter/exclude/get queries allowing _connector and _negated injection.
mitigation: Upgrade Django to 5.2.8 / 5.1.14 / 4.2.26. Do not unpack user-controlled dicts into ORM calls.

description: Permission model file system access bypass using crafted relative symlink paths.
mitigation: Update Node.js binary to latest active LTS patch release.

description: Omission of Vary: Cookie header on certain session key checks causing shared cache poisoning.
Path traversal in TemplateLookup.get_template() allowing arbitrary file reads outside templates dir.
mitigation: Upgrade Mako to >= 1.3.10; sanitize template identifier strings.
